## Meeting Purpose

[Review system glitches and discuss a major upcoming presentation.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=120.0)

## Key Takeaways

  - [**Critical Glitches Found:** The new Blankenberg canteen revealed bugs: meal orders are lost when workers switch canteens, and soup-only orders are miscounted and block check-ins.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=125.0)
  - [**Presentation Opportunity:** Filipe will present the project to \~1,000 attendees, including senior leadership, to secure buy-in for expansion. Adrian will provide data and help prepare.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=2580.0)
  - [**Food Waste Reduction:** The system is successfully cutting food waste, aligning with the new EU directive (30% reduction by 2030). This is a key selling point for the presentation.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=1890.0)
  - [**Admin Tooling:** An upcoming admin tool to place orders for workers is a high-priority fix for managing late selections and worker transfers.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=651.0)

## Topics

### System Glitches & Bugs

  - [**Worker Transfer Bug:** When a worker is moved to a new canteen mid-week, their meal selections are lost, defaulting to "incomplete."](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=143.0)
      - [**Impact:** Workers lose their meals, and the old canteen's order counts remain inflated.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=678.0)
      - [**Solution:** Adrian will implement an automatic order migration. A kitchen dashboard notification will alert chefs to count changes.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=678.0)
  - [**Soup-Only Order Bug:** Orders for soup only are miscounted and block check-ins.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=1022.0)
      - [**Impact:** The kitchen dashboard showed 26/27 meals distributed, hiding the missing soup order. The worker could not check in.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=1022.0)
      - [**Solution:** Adrian will fix the logic to correctly count soup-only orders and allow check-ins.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=1022.0)
  - [**Admin Check-in Logic:** Unclear if an admin's manual check-in is logged to their canteen or the worker's.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=902.0)
      - [**Expectation:** The check-in should be tied to the worker's canteen and meal order.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=902.0)
      - [**Action:** Adrian will verify and correct the logic if needed.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=902.0)
  - [**Kitchen User Access:** Kitchen staff cannot view their own meal selections or QR codes.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=747.0)
      - [**Solution:** Adrian will grant kitchen users the ability to switch between the kitchen and employee dashboards.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=747.0)
  - [**Admin Dashboard Scope:** Admins can only view distribution for their assigned canteen.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=857.0)
      - [**Solution:** Adrian will add a filter to allow admins to view all canteens.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=857.0)

### Presentation & Expansion Strategy

  - [**Opportunity:** Filipe will present the project to \~1,000 attendees, including senior leadership and partners, to secure buy-in for expansion.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=2580.0)
  - [**Key Selling Points:**](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=2893.0)
      - [**Food Waste Reduction:** The system is already reducing waste, directly addressing the new EU directive (30% reduction by 2030).](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=1890.0)
      - [**Worker Satisfaction:** Employees appreciate having a choice in their meals.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=2248.0)
      - [**Predictability & Cost Savings:** Data-driven ordering eliminates guesswork, improving kitchen efficiency and lowering costs.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=2178.0)
  - [**Presentation Plan:**](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=2514.0)
      - [**Format:** A concise 5–7 minute overview to generate interest.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=2514.0)
      - [**Materials:** A more detailed presentation will be available via QR code on physical cards.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=2975.0)
      - [**Support:** Adrian will provide real-world data (e.g., active users, scans) and help structure the narrative.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=1696.0)

### Product & Admin Tooling

  - [**Admin Order Placement Tool:** A high-priority tool is in development to allow admins to place orders for workers.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=651.0)
      - [**Significance:** This will solve the problem of late selections and enable admins to manage meals for transferred workers.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=1593.0)
  - [**On-Site Delivery Feature:** This feature is on the roadmap but not a current priority.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=480.0)
      - [**Initial Idea:** A "virtual canteen" could be created for on-site delivery, but this requires solving the order migration problem first.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=563.0)
  - [**iPhone App Installation:** Adrian has found a solution for the \~20 users with iPhones who cannot install the app.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=3566.0)
      - [**Action:** Adrian will send instructions to Filipe.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=3566.0)

### Operational & Billing Updates

  - [**QR Code Speed:** The recent QR code content change successfully increased scanning speed.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=3431.0)
  - [**App QR Code:** The app's main menu still displays the old, slower QR code.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=3480.0)
      - [**Action:** Adrian will update the app to show the new, faster QR code.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=3480.0)
  - [**October Invoice:** The invoice for 146 seats is correct and has been sent for payment.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=3316.0)
  - [**Pricing Proposal:** Adrian's pricing proposal is a basis for discussion, pending the presentation's outcome.](https://fathom.video/share/Kpp16q617AXhaRzz81UTJBauiziXcqsg?tab=summary&timestamp=3229.0)
